title: ZCC Compiler and General Boundary Engineering Cheatsheet
usage: Filter by scope or tags to generate design reviews, test plans, CI gates, and operational runbooks.
Treat reject_or_block as the failure gate and evidence as the proof artifact required before claiming a boundary is safe.
Adapt rules to the actual target/runtime; this reference does not prove a system satisfies the invariant.
tailoring: Compiler and distributed-system records are written for ZCC-style toolchains but remain implementation-neutral.

rule: Decode source with an explicitly selected encoding and preserve byte offsets.
invariant: Every diagnostic location maps to original bytes.
reject_or_block: Invalid byte sequences or implicit locale-dependent decoding.
evidence: Input digest, encoding label, byte-to-line map.
deterministic_test: Compile malformed UTF-8 and assert stable diagnostic span.
failure_response: Stop before lexing; report encoding error.

rule: Tokenize with a total, deterministic scanner that never silently skips bytes.
invariant: Every non-whitespace byte is classified or rejected.
reject_or_block: Unknown characters, unterminated literals, invalid escapes.
evidence: Token stream snapshot and source spans.
deterministic_test: Golden-test token streams for comments, escapes, CRLF, EOF.
failure_response: Emit lexical diagnostic; do not continue with invented tokens.

rule: Consume tokens through a grammar with bounded recovery rules.
invariant: Recovery never changes accepted program meaning.
reject_or_block: Ambiguous recovery, unbounded recursion, parser state reuse.
evidence: Parse tree/AST dump and diagnostic codes.
deterministic_test: Fuzz malformed expressions and assert termination plus stable error count.
failure_response: Fail compilation after bounded recovery.

rule: Construct typed AST nodes only through validated constructors.
invariant: AST nodes have complete spans and no impossible variant combinations.
reject_or_block: Missing spans, nullable required children, unknown node tags.
evidence: Serialized AST schema and constructor assertions.
deterministic_test: Round-trip AST serialization and schema validation.
failure_response: Reject construction and attach source span.

rule: Preserve macro expansion provenance separately from logical source locations.
invariant: Diagnostics can show expansion chain without losing call site.
reject_or_block: Recursive macro expansion beyond limit, undefined directive semantics.
evidence: Expansion trace, include graph, macro depth.
deterministic_test: Test nested macros, include cycles, and line directives.
failure_response: Abort offending expansion with explicit depth/cycle error.

rule: Resolve include paths against an allowlisted root and normalized relative paths.
invariant: No include escapes the configured source root.
reject_or_block: Absolute paths, traversal, symlink escape.
deterministic_test: Test ../ traversal, symlink escapes, and platform separators.
failure_response: Reject include with policy diagnostic.

rule: Create symbols in explicit scopes with deterministic shadowing rules.
invariant: A name resolves to exactly one visible declaration or a clear ambiguity error.
reject_or_block: Duplicate declarations, scope leaks, use-before-declare where forbidden.
deterministic_test: Compile nested shadowing and duplicate definitions.
failure_response: Reject at semantic phase.

rule: Use a closed type lattice and explicit conversion rules.
invariant: Every expression has one type or a diagnosed error.
reject_or_block: Implicit narrowing, uninitialized type variables, unsupported conversion.
evidence: Typed AST dump and conversion nodes.
deterministic_test: Test integer promotions, pointers, enums, and invalid casts.
failure_response: Reject invalid conversion; never infer unsafe fallback.

rule: Compute size, alignment, and field offsets from target ABI configuration.
invariant: Layout depends only on explicit target configuration.
reject_or_block: Host-dependent sizeof/alignment, packed-layout ambiguity.
evidence: Target triple, layout table, ABI fixture.
deterministic_test: Compare known struct layouts across targets.
failure_response: Fail on unsupported ABI feature.

rule: Evaluate constants with overflow and undefined-behavior policy visible in output.
invariant: Constant folding is semantics-preserving for the selected language mode.
reject_or_block: Host-number rounding, divide-by-zero folding, signed overflow ambiguity.
deterministic_test: Test boundary values and compile-time division failures.
failure_response: Produce diagnostic or target-mode-specific behavior.

rule: Render diagnostics from structured codes, spans, and notes; keep formatting separate.
invariant: Diagnostic identity is stable across renderers.
reject_or_block: String-matched error logic, missing source context, nondeterministic ordering.
evidence: Diagnostic JSON and rendered text snapshot.
deterministic_test: Snapshot test ANSI/plain/JSON modes.
failure_response: Return structured error; preserve all related spans.

rule: Enable syntax and semantics through named, versioned flags.
invariant: Unsupported constructs fail predictably under each mode.
reject_or_block: Implicit feature enablement from file suffix or environment.
evidence: Resolved feature matrix in build manifest.
deterministic_test: Compile same fixture under each supported mode.
failure_response: Reject feature with actionable flag guidance.

rule: Normalize language-specific constructs before shared optimization.
invariant: Cross-language lowering preserves declared semantics.
reject_or_block: Rust/C feature assumptions leaking into shared passes.
evidence: Lowering provenance and per-frontend conformance fixtures.
deterministic_test: Differential-test equivalent C/Rust snippets.
failure_response: Disable unsupported construct rather than approximate it.

rule: Treat plugins as untrusted extensions with versioned capability contracts.
invariant: Plugins cannot mutate compiler state outside declared hooks.
reject_or_block: Undeclared filesystem/network/process access.
evidence: Plugin manifest, hook trace, capability decision.
deterministic_test: Run malicious plugin fixtures in sandbox.
failure_response: Disable plugin and fail closed for required hooks.

rule: Parse flags once into a validated immutable configuration object.
invariant: Equivalent invocations yield identical configuration.
reject_or_block: Conflicting flags, environment overrides with hidden precedence.
deterministic_test: Test precedence, duplicates, and unknown flags.
failure_response: Reject conflicts; print resolved config.

rule: Read environment only through documented keys with explicit defaults.
invariant: Build output is not accidentally host-environment-dependent.
reject_or_block: PATH, locale, timezone, temp path, HOME affecting semantics.
deterministic_test: Compile under changed locale/TZ/PATH and compare artifacts.
failure_response: Ignore undeclared variables or fail in hermetic mode.

rule: Emit source mapping at every transformation boundary.
invariant: Generated instructions remain traceable to source or explicit synthetic origin.
reject_or_block: Dropped mappings, non-monotonic spans, stale macro locations.
deterministic_test: Map sampled assembly locations back to source fixtures.
failure_response: Mark synthetic origin; reject invalid map in debug builds.

rule: Key cached syntax products by source digest plus language/config versions.
invariant: No cache hit crosses incompatible compiler semantics.
reject_or_block: Timestamp-only keys, incomplete dependency closure.
evidence: Cache key manifest and hit/miss reason.
deterministic_test: Mutate included header and verify invalidation.
failure_response: Invalidate and rebuild affected unit.

rule: Only pass a partial AST forward when every consumer recognizes error nodes.
invariant: No optimization/codegen consumes fabricated semantics.
reject_or_block: Null/error nodes entering type or backend unchecked.
evidence: Error-node count and phase gate log.
deterministic_test: Compile invalid program and assert no object emission.
failure_response: Block emission when semantic errors exist.

rule: Apply bounded file size, token count, nesting depth, and expansion limits.
invariant: Adversarial source cannot cause unbounded CPU or memory.
reject_or_block: Huge literals, deep nesting, macro bombs, quadratic parser paths.
deterministic_test: Run max-limit and one-over-limit fixtures.
failure_response: Abort with budget-exceeded diagnostic.

rule: Lower through explicit semantic operations rather than stringly code emission.
invariant: Each IR instruction has declared operands, type, effects, and source origin.
reject_or_block: Ad hoc text assembly escaping type/effect checks.
evidence: IR schema, verifier results, lowering trace.
deterministic_test: Verify every IR module from golden fixtures.
failure_response: Stop compilation on verifier failure.

rule: Create blocks, terminators, and edges through a single CFG API.
invariant: Every reachable block has exactly one terminator.
reject_or_block: Fallthrough ambiguity, dangling targets, multiple terminators.
deterministic_test: Run CFG verifier on branches, loops, and error paths.
failure_response: Reject malformed function IR.

rule: Assign each SSA value one definition and validate dominance for every use.
invariant: No use can observe an undefined or non-dominating value.
reject_or_block: Use-before-definition, phi predecessor mismatch.
deterministic_test: Mutate IR to introduce bad dominance and assert rejection.
failure_response: Fail verifier before optimization.

rule: Keep phi inputs synchronized with CFG predecessor mutations.
invariant: A phi has exactly one input per live predecessor.
reject_or_block: Stale phi input after edge deletion, duplicate predecessor.
deterministic_test: Delete/add CFG edges in fixtures and re-verify.
failure_response: Rebuild phis or reject transform.

rule: Attach conservative alias/effect metadata and downgrade on uncertainty.
invariant: Optimization never assumes non-aliasing without proof.
reject_or_block: Unknown pointer provenance treated as non-aliasing.
deterministic_test: Differential-run alias-heavy C fixtures against reference output.
failure_response: Disable unsafe transform for uncertain aliasing.

rule: Model bit width, signedness, overflow behavior, and shifts in IR.
invariant: IR arithmetic matches selected language and target mode.
reject_or_block: Host integer semantics, out-of-range shift assumptions.
deterministic_test: Property-test edge cases for every integer width.
failure_response: Trap, diagnose, or preserve defined target behavior.

rule: Record precision, rounding, fast-math permissions, and exception model.
invariant: Optimization honors declared floating-point contract.
reject_or_block: Unmarked reassociation, host FPU variance, hidden fast-math.
deterministic_test: Compare strict versus fast-math fixtures.
failure_response: Disable transform without explicit permission.

rule: Make each pass a pure, ordered transformation with pre/post verification.
invariant: A pass cannot silently invalidate IR invariants.
reject_or_block: Pass order dependent global state, unchecked rewrite.
evidence: Pass name, version, before/after IR digests.
deterministic_test: Run verifier after each pass in audit mode.
failure_response: Rollback pass output and report failing transform.

rule: Fold only operations with fully known operands under active semantics.
invariant: Folded value equals runtime value for all defined inputs.
reject_or_block: Folding UB or environment-dependent results.
deterministic_test: Differential test folded/non-folded execution.
failure_response: Leave operation unfused when proof absent.

rule: Remove a computation only when it is provably effect-free and unused.
invariant: Observable behavior is preserved.
reject_or_block: Dropping volatile, atomic, trap-capable, or call effects.
deterministic_test: Test volatile loads, calls, div-by-zero, atomics.
failure_response: Retain uncertain instruction.

rule: Reuse values only when operands and effects dominate the use.
invariant: CSE cannot cross writes, calls, or control boundaries without proof.
reject_or_block: Incorrect reuse across aliasing or exceptional edges.
deterministic_test: Differential test with stores/calls between expressions.
failure_response: Skip CSE on uncertain effect boundary.

rule: Preserve loop entry/exit semantics, induction behavior, and side effects.
invariant: Loop transformations retain progress and observable ordering.
reject_or_block: Unsound unrolling, overflowed induction variables, mis-hoisted loads.
evidence: Loop analysis and transform proof hints.
deterministic_test: Test zero/one/many iterations plus overflow boundaries.
failure_response: Disable transform when trip count/effects are uncertain.

rule: Inline only after checking calling convention, visibility, recursion, and code-size budget.
invariant: Inlined and outlined calls are semantically equivalent.
reject_or_block: Inlining variadics/indirect calls/recursive cycles incorrectly.
deterministic_test: Compare inlined/non-inlined fixture outputs.
failure_response: Keep call when policy or proof fails.

rule: Allocate registers with target constraints, live intervals, and spill discipline.
invariant: No simultaneously live values share a register.
reject_or_block: Missing clobber, invalid spill slot, call-preserved violation.
deterministic_test: Execute register-pressure corpus; validate calling convention.
failure_response: Retry with safe allocator or fail codegen.

rule: Assign aligned, non-overlapping stack slots and preserve lifetime boundaries.
invariant: Frame layout satisfies ABI alignment and red-zone policy.
reject_or_block: Overlap live spills, wrong stack growth, unaligned slots.
deterministic_test: Run stack-heavy functions under sanitizer/emulator.
failure_response: Reject invalid frame layout.

rule: Marshal arguments, return values, clobbers, and stack alignment by target ABI.
invariant: Caller and callee agree on machine-level contract.
reject_or_block: Wrong register class, variadic mismatch, alignment breach.
evidence: Call-lowering trace and ABI fixture output.
deterministic_test: Link compiler-generated caller/callee combinations.
failure_response: Fail unsupported convention explicitly.

rule: Represent panic/unwind/longjmp behavior in explicit target policy.
invariant: Control transfers do not bypass required cleanups unknowingly.
reject_or_block: Assuming no-return or no-unwind incorrectly.
evidence: Function attributes and unwind table decision.
deterministic_test: Test noexcept/no-return/cleanup fixtures.
failure_response: Conservatively preserve cleanup/unwind edges.

rule: Validate legal orderings and preserve atomicity through lowering.
invariant: Atomic operations cannot be weakened by optimization.
reject_or_block: Dropping fences, invalid acquire/release pairing.
deterministic_test: Run litmus-style tests where supported.
failure_response: Reject unsupported ordering or use stronger safe order.

rule: Select instructions from a versioned target description.
invariant: Every selected instruction has legal operand forms.
reject_or_block: Implicit host ISA features, illegal addressing modes.
deterministic_test: Assemble generated output against target assembler.
failure_response: Fail with unsupported-target diagnostic.

rule: Render assembly through escaping and operand-format rules.
invariant: Assembly text is syntactically valid and unambiguous.
reject_or_block: Raw user strings entering asm, locale formatting, label collisions.
deterministic_test: Assemble every emitted golden program.
failure_response: Block emission on renderer validation failure.

rule: Generate collision-free, scoped, deterministic symbol names.
invariant: Symbols resolve consistently under linking and debug modes.
reject_or_block: User-controlled labels, duplicate temporary names, unstable counters.
deterministic_test: Compile same unit twice and compare symbol list.
failure_response: Rename internally or reject external collision.

rule: Keep debug references synchronized with final code layout.
invariant: Debug info never points outside source/object ranges.
reject_or_block: Stale line tables after optimization, wrong file identity.
evidence: Debug table verifier and source digests.
deterministic_test: Run debugger/source-map consistency fixture.
failure_response: Omit invalid entry and report internal error.

rule: Compare outputs at semantic boundaries, not byte identity alone.
invariant: Equivalent inputs produce equivalent observable results.
reject_or_block: Assuming AST/IR assembly must match byte-for-byte.
evidence: Differential execution result, exit code, stdout, memory checks.
deterministic_test: Run cross-backend corpus and minimize mismatch.
failure_response: Quarantine mismatch with reproducer.

rule: Use differential tests across interpreters/emulators/native runs where available.
invariant: Mismatch is evidence, not proof of which side is correct.
reject_or_block: One oracle bug masking another.
deterministic_test: Run randomized programs with independently checked semantics.
failure_response: Preserve failing seed; mark unresolved.

rule: Convert internal assertions into structured compiler-bug reports at public boundary.
invariant: A malformed input cannot crash the host process silently.
reject_or_block: Uncaught exceptions, assertion-only diagnostics.
evidence: Crash report with phase, input digest, stack trace.
deterministic_test: Fuzz parser/IR and assert no unhandled process exit.
failure_response: Return compiler-internal-error code; retain reproducer.

rule: Version IR schema and validate on read before reuse.
invariant: Old/foreign IR never masquerades as current IR.
reject_or_block: Schema drift, endian assumptions, partial writes.
deterministic_test: Load old/corrupt cache corpus.
failure_response: Invalidate and rebuild.

rule: Record technical metadata without capturing source contents by default.
invariant: Observability does not leak customer code.
reject_or_block: Raw source, secret paths, symbol names in logs.
evidence: Redaction report and explicit opt-in payload.
deterministic_test: Inject secrets into fixture and scan telemetry.
failure_response: Redact; suppress event; alert policy violation.

rule: Enforce budgets per translation unit and per optimization phase.
invariant: One pathological unit cannot starve the build.
reject_or_block: Exponential passes, unlimited inlining, oversized CFG.
deterministic_test: Run adversarial inputs at fixed limits.
failure_response: Cancel unit with deterministic resource error.

rule: Gate extensions by explicit CPU/VM feature flags.
invariant: No unsupported opcode appears in baseline target output.
reject_or_block: Auto-detecting host CPU, leaking newer ISA instructions.
evidence: Target feature manifest and opcode audit.
deterministic_test: Disassemble baseline build and assert allowed opcode set.
failure_response: Reject feature or lower to baseline sequence.

rule: Seed all randomized heuristics from recorded input-derived state.
invariant: Same inputs/config produce same artifact bytes when supported.
reject_or_block: Random allocation order, timestamp labels, hash iteration order.
deterministic_test: Repeat N builds in clean directories and compare.
failure_response: Use stable ordering; fail reproducibility gate.

rule: Compare stage artifacts with declared equivalence criteria and toolchain closure.
invariant: Self-host claim has recorded inputs, stages, and comparison mode.
reject_or_block: Comparing only exit status, hidden bootstrap compiler variance.
deterministic_test: Run stage1/stage2/stage3 clean bootstrap fixture.
failure_response: Mark non-convergent; retain full evidence.

rule: Validate object format, architecture, relocations, and symbol visibility before link.
invariant: All inputs target the same compatible ABI unless explicitly bridged.
reject_or_block: Mixed architecture, malformed relocation, duplicate strong symbols.
deterministic_test: Link intentional mismatch fixtures.
failure_response: Stop link with source object attribution.

rule: Apply relocation formulas only for legal section/type combinations.
invariant: Relocated code/data points to valid mapped symbols.
reject_or_block: Overflowed relocation, undefined weak/strong confusion.
deterministic_test: Test near/far address and overflow fixtures.
failure_response: Fail link or insert defined trampoline only when supported.

rule: Resolve dependencies from locked, ordered, recorded search roots.
invariant: Build never links an accidental host library.
reject_or_block: Ambient system paths, version drift, shadowed library name.
deterministic_test: Build with poisoned PATH/LIBRARY_PATH.
failure_response: Reject undeclared dependency.

rule: Treat linker scripts as privileged configuration with validated ranges.
invariant: Sections cannot overlap reserved or executable-policy regions.
reject_or_block: Arbitrary memory placement, writable executable sections.
deterministic_test: Validate section ranges and permission matrix.
failure_response: Reject invalid script/mapping.

rule: Verify executable header, segment permissions, interpreter, and target compatibility.
invariant: Loader-facing metadata matches generated code assumptions.
reject_or_block: RWX segment, wrong interpreter, malformed header.
deterministic_test: Run objdump/readelf-style validation in CI.
failure_response: Quarantine artifact.

rule: Key each action by full declared inputs, tools, flags, and environment.
invariant: No stale action output is reused across semantic changes.
reject_or_block: Missing header/tool/config in cache key.
evidence: Action manifest and input digest tree.
deterministic_test: Change each input class and assert rebuild.
failure_response: Invalidate action and descendants.

rule: Resolve package versions once and commit immutable integrity metadata.
invariant: A clean install selects identical dependency graph.
reject_or_block: Floating versions, multiple lockfiles, mutable tags.
evidence: Lockfile digest and package integrity list.
deterministic_test: Fresh install in isolated environment.
failure_response: Fail install on lock drift.

rule: Exclude generated/temp/secrets via explicit allowlist packaging.
invariant: Artifact contains only intended files.
reject_or_block: Globs that include .env, caches, node_modules, private keys.
deterministic_test: Build package from hostile tree with decoy secrets.
failure_response: Reject unexpected file; fail release gate.

rule: Change semantic version based on documented API/ABI/schema impact.
invariant: Consumers can predict upgrade risk.
reject_or_block: Silent breaking change, reused version tag.
deterministic_test: Compare public surface against previous release.
failure_response: Block publish pending version correction.

rule: Sign immutable digests with protected release identity and verify before promotion.
invariant: Promotion references exact signed artifact bytes.
reject_or_block: Signing mutable filenames, unsigned rebuild after approval.
deterministic_test: Verify signature after download and mirror copy.
failure_response: Reject promotion if verification fails.

rule: Separate untrusted PR execution from credentials and release permissions.
invariant: Untrusted code cannot access publishing secrets.
reject_or_block: Fork PR token leakage, write permissions in test jobs.
evidence: Workflow permission matrix and audit log.
deterministic_test: Run malicious PR fixture with secret probes.
failure_response: Use read-only/no-secret context.

rule: Gate on deterministic required checks and preserve failure artifacts.
invariant: A passing badge maps to actual tested revision.
reject_or_block: Flaky retry hiding defects, stale status from old commit.
evidence: Commit SHA, test seed, artifact links.
deterministic_test: Force failure then verify merge block.
failure_response: Block merge; open flake issue if nondeterministic.

rule: Use coverage as signal, not proof; require targeted behavioral tests.
invariant: Critical invariants have direct tests regardless of line coverage.
reject_or_block: Chasing percentage while missing race/error paths.
evidence: Coverage report plus invariant test inventory.
deterministic_test: Remove assertion while retaining line coverage.
failure_response: Fail invariant suite independently.

rule: Pin hardware/runtime/config and report distributions, not one sample.
invariant: Performance comparisons are reproducible and contextual.
reject_or_block: Comparing noisy runs, optimizer removed work, changed inputs.
evidence: Benchmark manifest, raw samples, confidence interval.
deterministic_test: Run control/no-op benchmark and regression fixture.
failure_response: Mark inconclusive; do not publish claim.

rule: Apply ordered, idempotent, backwards-compatible changes with verification queries.
invariant: Old and new application versions coexist during rollout.
reject_or_block: Destructive DDL before readers migrate, untracked manual changes.
evidence: Migration ID, checksum, before/after schema dump.
deterministic_test: Apply twice in clean/staged databases.
failure_response: Stop rollout and execute documented rollback.

rule: Validate flag owner, default, expiry, audience, and rollback before use.
invariant: A flag cannot become permanent undocumented configuration.
reject_or_block: Unknown flags, global unsafe enablement, no expiry.
deterministic_test: Test default/off/on/expired cases.
failure_response: Use safe default; reject expired flag.

rule: Set retention by policy and preserve legal/security evidence separately.
invariant: Cleanup does not remove required recovery inputs.
reject_or_block: Deleting latest known-good artifact or incident evidence.
deterministic_test: Simulate rollback after cleanup window.
failure_response: Prevent deletion; escalate policy conflict.

rule: Make rollback a tested deployment action with compatible data assumptions.
invariant: Rollback restores service without corrupting persisted state.
reject_or_block: Rolling back code after forward-only schema mutation.
deterministic_test: Perform staged rollback drill.
failure_response: Halt deployment; use forward fix where rollback unsafe.

rule: Pin tool version and verify distribution integrity/capabilities.
invariant: Toolchain changes are reviewable source changes.
reject_or_block: Curl-pipe install, unpinned action/container, unverified binary.
deterministic_test: Rebuild using altered tool version and detect drift.
failure_response: Block tool use pending verification.

rule: Keep commands tied to exact versions and verified in CI where practical.
invariant: Runbooks do not instruct unsafe or stale operations.
reject_or_block: Copy-paste commands with placeholders or hidden destructive defaults.
evidence: Docs test result and version stamp.
deterministic_test: Execute docs snippets in disposable environment.
failure_response: Mark command obsolete; block release if critical.

rule: Limit body size, content type, encoding, and parse depth before deserialization.
invariant: Untrusted requests cannot allocate unbounded memory or create ambiguous values.
reject_or_block: Missing content length, oversized chunks, duplicate keys ambiguity.
evidence: Request policy decision and parsed schema version.
deterministic_test: Send oversize, malformed JSON, duplicate-key fixtures.
failure_response: Return bounded 4xx; do not partially act.

rule: Validate schema, ranges, unions, and unknown fields at the edge.
invariant: Internal code receives narrow typed objects only.
reject_or_block: Broad any/unknown propagation, coercion surprises.
deterministic_test: Test missing, extra, wrong-type, boundary values.
failure_response: Reject with field-level error code.

rule: Use canonical formats, length limits, and authorization-scoped queries.
invariant: An ID cannot select resources outside caller scope.
reject_or_block: Path traversal IDs, enumeration, cross-tenant lookup.
deterministic_test: Try malformed/foreign IDs against fixture store.
failure_response: Return not-found or forbidden consistently.

rule: Map methods to explicit idempotency and side-effect policies.
invariant: Retries cannot create accidental duplicate side effects.
reject_or_block: POST without idempotency key, unsafe GET mutation.
evidence: Request method, idempotency key, outcome record.
deterministic_test: Replay identical request concurrently.
failure_response: Return prior result or conflict per contract.

rule: Verify signature, issuer, audience, time bounds, and revocation policy before use.
invariant: Every authorization decision uses an authenticated principal.
reject_or_block: Accepting unsigned/expired/wrong-audience tokens.
evidence: Token verification outcome without raw token.
deterministic_test: Test invalid alg, expired, wrong aud, clock skew.
failure_response: Reject with generic auth error.

rule: Authorize each action/resource combination server-side.
invariant: UI visibility never substitutes for access control.
reject_or_block: Role-only coarse checks, confused deputy, stale ownership.
evidence: Policy rule ID and decision trace.
deterministic_test: Test cross-tenant and privilege-escalation matrix.
failure_response: Deny by default; log decision.

rule: Apply identity-aware quotas with bounded state and retry hints.
invariant: One actor cannot exhaust shared capacity unfairly.
reject_or_block: IP-only identity, unbounded counters, missing endpoint weights.
deterministic_test: Burst and distributed-client test.
failure_response: Return 429 with retry guidance; preserve core capacity.

rule: Bind values through parameterized queries and enforce pagination caps.
invariant: User text cannot change SQL structure or force full scan.
reject_or_block: String concatenation, unlimited limit/offset, dynamic identifiers.
evidence: Query template ID and parameter types.
deterministic_test: Inject SQL metacharacters and huge page sizes.
failure_response: Reject/normalize input; use safe query path.

rule: Serialize through versioned response schema with explicit nullability.
invariant: Clients receive stable fields and types.
reject_or_block: Leaking internal errors, accidental field removal, NaN/Infinity JSON.
evidence: Response schema version and redaction result.
deterministic_test: Contract-test old/new clients.
failure_response: Return compatible response or versioned error.

rule: Separate safe public error codes from internal diagnostics.
invariant: Clients get actionable, non-sensitive failures.
reject_or_block: Stack traces, SQL text, secrets, backend topology.
evidence: Public code, correlation ID, redaction log.
deterministic_test: Trigger internal exception and inspect response.
failure_response: Return sanitized 5xx; retain internal trace.

rule: Verify signature, timestamp, replay nonce, and provider identity before enqueueing.
invariant: External delivery cannot forge/replay internal action.
reject_or_block: Signature over wrong bytes, unlimited replay window.
deterministic_test: Replay signed payload inside/outside window.
failure_response: Reject and record security event.

rule: Allow explicit origins/methods/headers; never reflect arbitrary origin with credentials.
invariant: Browser credentials are shared only with approved origins.
reject_or_block: Wildcard credentials, origin reflection, preflight drift.
evidence: CORS policy match and request origin.
deterministic_test: Test trusted/untrusted/null origins.
failure_response: Omit CORS grant; return normal server policy.

rule: Stream with quotas, content sniffing, filename normalization, and malware scan hooks.
invariant: Upload cannot escape storage policy or masquerade as trusted content.
reject_or_block: Pathnames, zip bombs, executable content served inline.
evidence: Upload manifest, detected type, size, digest.
deterministic_test: Upload polyglot/oversize/traversal fixtures.
failure_response: Quarantine or reject; never publish directly.

rule: Parse and validate scheme, host, DNS result, redirect chain, and response budget.
invariant: Server-side fetch cannot reach private/control-plane networks without authorization.
reject_or_block: SSRF via localhost, metadata IPs, redirects, DNS rebinding.
evidence: Resolved host/IP chain and policy decision.
deterministic_test: Test private IP, decimal IP, redirect, rebinding fixture.
failure_response: Block request; log sanitized target.

rule: Include all behavior-affecting request dimensions and isolate tenants/users.
invariant: Cache never returns one user’s data to another.
reject_or_block: Omitting Authorization, locale, feature version, query normalization.
evidence: Cache key components and hit source.
deterministic_test: Cross-user/cache poisoning test.
failure_response: Bypass/evict invalid entry.

rule: Encode opaque signed/versioned cursor with stable sort keys.
invariant: Pages neither duplicate nor skip items under declared consistency mode.
reject_or_block: Offset drift, user-editable cursor, unstable sort.
evidence: Cursor version, sort key, scope binding.
deterministic_test: Insert/delete between page requests.
failure_response: Reject invalid cursor; state consistency caveat.

rule: Expose idempotency, retryable codes, and backoff hints explicitly.
invariant: Retry behavior aligns with actual side-effect semantics.
reject_or_block: Retrying terminal 4xx, duplicate writes, no timeout budget.
deterministic_test: Simulate lost response after commit.
failure_response: Return replayable result or durable status handle.

rule: Deprecate through measured usage, notice windows, and migration tests.
invariant: Retirement does not surprise active supported consumers.
reject_or_block: Breaking unversioned field change, undocumented sunset.
deterministic_test: Contract-test supported version matrix.
failure_response: Keep adapter or delay retirement.

rule: Encode by output context and prohibit raw HTML unless sanitized policy permits it.
invariant: Input cannot become executable markup/script.
reject_or_block: InnerHTML from raw input, unsafe URL/style contexts.
deterministic_test: XSS corpus across HTML/attr/URL/JS contexts.
failure_response: Escape/reject/sanitize according to context.

rule: Normalize comparison forms deliberately while preserving display bytes when required.
invariant: Equivalent identifiers cannot bypass uniqueness or authorization.
reject_or_block: Mixed scripts, confusables, normalization mismatch.
deterministic_test: Test NFC/NFKC/confusable fixtures.
failure_response: Reject ambiguous identifiers or require confirmation.

rule: Use server-controlled monotonic/UTC semantics and bounded skew handling.
invariant: Expiry is not based on client-provided clock alone.
reject_or_block: Timestamp equality, timezone parsing, clock rollback.
deterministic_test: Test skew, leap-like boundary, delayed delivery.
failure_response: Fail safely; renew with explicit lease rules.

rule: Load secrets from protected runtime bindings and never echo them into logs/errors/artifacts.
invariant: No secret crosses user-visible or build-cache boundary.
reject_or_block: Secrets in source, query strings, client bundles.
evidence: Secret reference ID and redaction scan.
deterministic_test: Scan fixture logs/builds containing sentinel secret.
failure_response: Block output; rotate leaked secret.

rule: Scope all reads/writes/indexes/cache keys/events by tenant boundary.
invariant: One tenant cannot infer or mutate another tenant’s state.
reject_or_block: Missing tenant predicate, global unique constraint collision.
deterministic_test: Cross-tenant access/property tests.
failure_response: Deny and create incident signal.

rule: Accept old/new payloads only through explicit migration adapters and sunset rules.
invariant: Schema evolution is observable and reversible.
reject_or_block: Silently reinterpreting old field semantics.
deterministic_test: Replay archived old payload fixtures.
failure_response: Reject unsupported version with migration guidance.

rule: Assign stable message ID, idempotency key, schema version, and trace metadata before enqueue.
invariant: Every message can be deduplicated and diagnosed independently.
reject_or_block: Ephemeral IDs, missing schema/version, mutable payload after send.
evidence: Message envelope digest and enqueue result.
deterministic_test: Send duplicate/concurrent messages and compare handling.
failure_response: Reject malformed envelope; publish only durable message.

rule: Assume at-least-once delivery and validate every message before side effects.
invariant: Duplicate or delayed delivery cannot corrupt state.
reject_or_block: Exactly-once claim without end-to-end proof.
evidence: Delivery attempt, message ID, validation result.
deterministic_test: Replay same message across parallel consumers.
failure_response: Acknowledge only after defined durable transition.

rule: Claim work with owner, expiry, fence/version, and affected-row check.
invariant: Only current lease holder may mutate claimed work.
reject_or_block: Read-then-decide race, owner-only guard, timestamp equality freshness.
deterministic_test: Race two claimers and advance clock past lease.
failure_response: No-op stale claimant; retry safe candidate.

rule: Guard every mutation by ID + owner + unexpired lease + fence/version.
invariant: Late workers cannot overwrite new owners.
reject_or_block: Mutation guarded only by ID or stale owner.
deterministic_test: Simulate expired worker finalizing after re-claim.
failure_response: Treat zero rows as lost lease; do not retry mutation blindly.

rule: Commit domain change and outbox intent in one atomic database transaction when supported.
invariant: No committed business event is missing its delivery intent.
reject_or_block: Writing database then enqueueing separately.
deterministic_test: Force crash between statements in test harness.
failure_response: Rollback both or retry transaction.

rule: Model send-success/finalize-failure as at-least-once risk and rely on downstream idempotency.
invariant: A sent event may be redelivered but not silently lost.
reject_or_block: Deleting before send, claiming exactly-once from queue API.
evidence: Send attempt ID, finalize guard, downstream dedupe key.
deterministic_test: Inject failure after successful send.
failure_response: Leave/retry outbox; downstream de-duplicates.

rule: Classify retryable failures separately from malformed and terminal failures.
invariant: Retries are bounded, delayed, observable, and non-blocking.
reject_or_block: Retrying validation errors, immediate hot-loop, no max attempts.
evidence: Error class, attempt count, next attempt time.
deterministic_test: Simulate 429/timeout/permanent 4xx cases.
failure_response: Back off or quarantine per taxonomy.

rule: Move irrecoverable messages to a durable quarantine with original envelope and reason.
invariant: Poison payload cannot starve healthy traffic.
reject_or_block: Infinite retry, data-loss discard, shared retry counter ambiguity.
evidence: DLQ record, failure code, redaction status.
deterministic_test: Feed malformed payload repeatedly.
failure_response: Quarantine; expose operator re-drive path.

rule: Use server time as advisory; protect correctness with fences and monotonic versions.
invariant: Clock skew cannot authorize stale ownership.
reject_or_block: Lease freshness based solely on equal milliseconds.
deterministic_test: Run skewed worker simulation.
failure_response: Reject stale version even if local time looks valid.

rule: Record individual results; never let one poison item erase successful accounting.
invariant: Batch acknowledgement matches durable per-message state.
reject_or_block: All-or-nothing ack without transaction, hidden partial failure.
evidence: Per-message outcome list and batch summary.
deterministic_test: Mix valid, duplicate, malformed, transient items.
failure_response: Ack/quarantine/retry each under policy.

rule: Version events and make unknown fields/versions explicit.
invariant: Consumers do not silently reinterpret producer changes.
reject_or_block: Implicit JSON shape reliance, unknown enum defaulting.
deterministic_test: Replay old/new/malformed events.
failure_response: Reject unsupported version or route adapter.

rule: Bind idempotency key to request fingerprint and durable result, not just timestamp.
invariant: A reused key cannot authorize different payload semantics.
reject_or_block: Key collision across endpoint/tenant/payload.
evidence: Key namespace, payload hash, result ID.
deterministic_test: Reuse same key with altered body.
failure_response: Return conflict; retain original result.

rule: Use atomic updates/compare-and-swap or serializable transaction pattern.
invariant: Counters never lose increments under overlap.
reject_or_block: Read-modify-write without guard.
deterministic_test: Parallel increment stress test.
failure_response: Retry CAS or use atomic statement.

rule: Encode allowed transitions in guarded SQL/application rules with terminal taxonomy.
invariant: Every state change is legal, attributable, and recoverable.
reject_or_block: Free-form status strings, terminal state resurrection.
deterministic_test: Attempt every illegal transition.
failure_response: Reject and log transition violation.

rule: Treat isolates as overlapping, retrying, and independently failing.
invariant: No correctness depends on in-memory singleton state.
reject_or_block: Global mutable memory locks, local cache as authority.
deterministic_test: Run concurrent isolate simulation.
failure_response: Move authority to durable guarded store.

rule: Use parameter binding, constraints, indexes, and checked row counts.
invariant: Database guards enforce key invariants even if application races.
reject_or_block: String SQL, missing unique/check constraint, ignoring changes count.
evidence: Prepared statement ID, constraint result, rows changed.
deterministic_test: Inject concurrent conflicts and invalid values.
failure_response: Handle constraint conflict as a domain outcome.

rule: Schedule durable periodic recovery for expired leases and delayed retries.
invariant: Work is eventually rediscovered after missed wake-up.
reject_or_block: Relying only on waitUntil or one consumer event.
evidence: Recovery cursor, scan window, recovered IDs.
deterministic_test: Kill worker after claim and advance time.
failure_response: Reclaim under fence; alert if backlog grows.

rule: Emit structured transition events with stable IDs and bounded cardinality.
invariant: Operators can reconstruct lifecycle without exposing payload secrets.
reject_or_block: Unbounded labels, raw PII/payload logs, missing trace link.
evidence: Trace ID, message ID, transition metrics.
deterministic_test: Trace single item across enqueue/retry/DLQ.
failure_response: Record sanitized event; open alert on invariant breach.

rule: Advertise/implement bounded concurrency and capacity-aware admission.
invariant: Overload degrades predictably instead of cascading.
reject_or_block: Unlimited fan-out, retry amplification, no queue depth cap.
evidence: Concurrency limit, queue depth, rejection reason.
deterministic_test: Load test beyond capacity.
failure_response: Throttle/reject; preserve critical lanes.

rule: Define data locality, retry, and reconciliation behavior for partitions.
invariant: Partition cannot create unbounded conflicting authority.
reject_or_block: Assuming global instant consistency, blind last-write-wins.
deterministic_test: Simulate timeout/partition/reordered delivery.
failure_response: Use durable conflict policy; surface uncertain outcome.

rule: Make schedule trigger idempotent and tolerant of missed/duplicate invocations.
invariant: Cron overlap/miss does not duplicate destructive work.
reject_or_block: Assuming exactly one scheduled run.
deterministic_test: Invoke same schedule concurrently and skip interval.
failure_response: Claim work durably; catch up from watermark.

rule: Use an intent/result protocol and reconciliation for non-transactional external APIs.
invariant: Unknown remote outcome remains retryable and auditable.
reject_or_block: Assuming timeout means no side effect.
evidence: External idempotency key, request digest, status probe.
deterministic_test: Drop response after remote accepted request.
failure_response: Query/retry idempotently; mark uncertain.

rule: Require operator identity, reason, scope limit, and replay-safe policy.
invariant: Human remediation cannot bypass idempotency or audit trail.
reject_or_block: Bulk replay with no limits/audit.
evidence: Operator ID, selected IDs, reason, approvals.
deterministic_test: Attempt re-drive terminal and already-complete items.
failure_response: Validate scope; create audited recovery action.

rule: Retain enough immutable envelope/state history to explain/replay within policy.
invariant: Replay never depends on deleted opaque state.
reject_or_block: Deleting payload/source before investigation window.
evidence: Retention class, deletion time, archive digest.
deterministic_test: Replay record near retention edge.
failure_response: Block purge or mark replay unavailable explicitly.

rule: Normalize separators; require relative, canonical paths under destination root.
invariant: Extraction never writes outside destination root.
reject_or_block: Absolute paths, ../ traversal, drive prefixes, NUL names.
deterministic_test: Test traversal, mixed separator, drive, NUL fixtures.
failure_response: Reject suspicious entry.

rule: Reject symlinks, hardlinks, device files, and unsafe mode bits unless explicit policy handles them.
invariant: Archive contents cannot redirect or create special files.
reject_or_block: Symlink escape, FIFO/device extraction, executable surprise.
deterministic_test: Build archive with symlink/device entries.
failure_response: Quarantine/reject entry.

rule: Enforce entry count, per-entry size, total size, and compression-ratio ceilings while streaming.
invariant: Archive cannot exhaust memory/disk/CPU.
reject_or_block: Zip bomb, whole-archive buffering, unbounded decompression.
deterministic_test: Extract high-ratio and too-many-entry fixtures.
failure_response: Abort extraction; delete partial destination.

rule: List and validate every entry before reporting package success.
invariant: Success claim includes actual path/size/hash inventory.
reject_or_block: Trusting archive header only, ignoring duplicate names.
evidence: Manifest with digest and rejection count.
deterministic_test: Package duplicate/collision names and inspect manifest.
failure_response: Fail package validation.

rule: Emit standards-compliant archive structure and validate output with an independent reader.
invariant: Archive bytes are consumable by standard tools.
reject_or_block: Custom deflate blob mislabeled as ZIP, missing central directory.
evidence: ZIP structure report, CRCs, byte size.
deterministic_test: Open artifact with independent unzip implementation.
failure_response: Reject artifact; do not upload.

rule: Generate keys from controlled namespaces and canonical IDs.
invariant: User data cannot overwrite unrelated object namespace.
reject_or_block: User-controlled keys, traversal semantics, key collision.
deterministic_test: Try collision/traversal-like keys.
failure_response: Reject or prefix isolate.

rule: Set content type, disposition, cache policy, and access level from trusted classification.
invariant: Stored bytes are not served with unsafe executable semantics.
reject_or_block: Content-type from filename, inline HTML from untrusted upload.
deterministic_test: Upload HTML/SVG/polyglot and request it.
failure_response: Force attachment/safe type or private access.

rule: Await required write completion or record async status before claiming persistence.
invariant: Caller knows whether object is durable, pending, or failed.
reject_or_block: waitUntil-only persistence reported as complete.
deterministic_test: Terminate request after scheduling async write.
failure_response: Return pending status; reconcile failure.

rule: Use versioning/retention/legal-hold policy before destructive deletes.
invariant: Deletion is recoverable or explicitly irreversible by policy.
reject_or_block: Immediate permanent delete of incident/release artifacts.
deterministic_test: Attempt delete protected object.
failure_response: Deny/retain per policy.

rule: Use cryptographic digest over exact bytes and record algorithm.
invariant: Content identity is independent of filename/location.
reject_or_block: Hashing transformed text or metadata only.
deterministic_test: Alter one byte and assert digest mismatch.
failure_response: Treat as distinct/corrupt object.

rule: Validate metadata separately from content and never treat client metadata as authorization.
invariant: Metadata cannot promote an object to trusted state.
reject_or_block: Client-supplied verified flag, role, content type.
deterministic_test: Upload object with privileged metadata values.
failure_response: Overwrite with server-derived metadata.

rule: Bind signed URLs to object, method, expiry, and optionally requester constraints.
invariant: Leaked URL has narrow, time-bounded capability.
reject_or_block: Wildcard method/path, long expiry, no revocation plan.
deterministic_test: Modify path/method/expiry in fixture.
failure_response: Reject signature mismatch; revoke key when needed.

rule: Test restore from independent backup media and verify checksums/schema compatibility.
invariant: Backup is usable, not merely present.
reject_or_block: Untested backups, same-account-only copy, missing encryption key.
deterministic_test: Restore representative artifact/database snapshot.
failure_response: Escalate failed restore; keep source intact.

rule: Define validation/TTL/invalidation path for each cached object.
invariant: Cache does not serve revoked or incompatible content beyond policy.
reject_or_block: Infinite immutable cache for mutable artifact.
evidence: Cache headers, versioned key, purge record.
deterministic_test: Publish revocation then request cached resource.
failure_response: Use versioned path/purge/short TTL.

rule: Classify sensitive fields before storage and apply redaction plus retention limits.
invariant: Logs aid diagnosis without becoming a secret database.
reject_or_block: Raw payloads/tokens, indefinite retention.
deterministic_test: Inject sentinel PII/secret and scan stored logs.
failure_response: Block/redact; rotate where needed.

rule: Name assets, actors, entry points, assumptions, and abuse cases before design.
invariant: Security controls map to explicit threats, not slogans.
reject_or_block: Unstated trust assumptions, generic checklist theater.
evidence: Threat model revision and abuse-case matrix.
deterministic_test: Review new endpoint against threat model.
failure_response: Block launch until high-risk gaps resolved.

rule: Grant least-privilege, short-lived, auditable capabilities instead of broad ambient roles.
invariant: Compromise blast radius is bounded.
reject_or_block: Admin-by-default, shared credentials, permanent tokens.
evidence: Capability scope, expiry, issuer, audit record.
deterministic_test: Attempt action outside granted scope.
failure_response: Deny and log.

rule: Support dual-validity overlap, revocation, and verification of rollout completion.
invariant: Rotation does not cause outage or leave old secret active indefinitely.
reject_or_block: Single-step replacement, no inventory, old key never revoked.
evidence: Rotation plan and key usage metrics.
deterministic_test: Rotate in staging with old/new clients.
failure_response: Roll back safely or revoke compromised credential.

rule: Use proven constructions with explicit nonce/key/algorithm/version handling.
invariant: Security does not depend on undocumented defaults.
reject_or_block: Nonce reuse, custom crypto, algorithm confusion.
evidence: Algorithm ID, key ID, nonce policy.
deterministic_test: Known-answer and misuse tests.
failure_response: Reject invalid parameters; rotate affected keys.

rule: Sandbox by process/runtime policy, resource caps, and no ambient credentials.
invariant: Guest code cannot access host authority by default.
reject_or_block: Executing user code in build/controller process.
deterministic_test: Run escape/probe fixtures.
failure_response: Terminate sandbox; preserve evidence.

rule: Assess provenance, maintenance, permissions, and transitive risk before trust.
invariant: A dependency’s access matches its necessity.
reject_or_block: Unreviewed install scripts, typosquatting, unused high-privilege package.
deterministic_test: Inject compromised test dependency in CI.
failure_response: Block/update/replace dependency.

rule: Triage severity, exploit preconditions, affected versions, mitigation, and disclosure path.
invariant: Security decisions are evidence-based and traceable.
reject_or_block: Severity by intuition, public disclosure before mitigation.
deterministic_test: Reproduce minimal proof in safe environment.
failure_response: Patch/mitigate; coordinate disclosure.

rule: Make audit events append-oriented, actor-bound, time-stamped, and tamper-evident where needed.
invariant: Critical actions are attributable and reconstructible.
reject_or_block: Mutable logs, shared accounts, missing before/after state.
evidence: Event ID, actor, correlation, integrity chain.
deterministic_test: Attempt alteration/deletion and verify detection.
failure_response: Alert and preserve immutable copy.

rule: Define severity, owner, containment, communication, and evidence preservation steps.
invariant: Response begins from a known safe posture.
reject_or_block: Ad hoc deletion/log loss, no owner, speculative public claims.
deterministic_test: Tabletop compromised token/queue replay scenario.
failure_response: Contain, rotate, preserve evidence, investigate.

rule: Translate intent into observable pass/fail behaviors and non-goals.
invariant: Delivery can be verified without interpretation drift.
reject_or_block: Vague adjectives, hidden stakeholder assumptions.
deterministic_test: Review criterion against counterexamples.
failure_response: Return for clarification or choose explicit assumption.

rule: Bind approval to immutable artifact, diff, environment, and expiry.
invariant: Approver knows exactly what is being authorized.
reject_or_block: Approving branch name/latest build, long-lived blanket approval.
deterministic_test: Attempt deploy rebuilt artifact after approval.
failure_response: Require re-approval.

rule: Encode repetitive risky actions as guarded tools with dry-run and audit.
invariant: Manual operations become reproducible and bounded.
reject_or_block: Copy-paste production SQL, no preview, no rollback.
evidence: Command parameters, dry-run output, audit event.
deterministic_test: Run tool against staging and invalid scope.
failure_response: Abort safely; require explicit confirmation policy.

rule: Keep runbooks concise, versioned, owner-assigned, and tested during drills.
invariant: Instructions work under pressure and current environment.
reject_or_block: Stale commands, missing permissions, destructive default.
deterministic_test: Execute drill from runbook only.
failure_response: Mark stale; remediate before next release.

rule: Alert only on actionable, owner-routable symptoms with clear severity.
invariant: Pages drive response, not noise.
reject_or_block: Threshold without context, duplicate alerts, no owner.
deterministic_test: Inject known failure and verify single actionable page.
failure_response: Deduplicate/tune; create ticket for non-actionable signal.

rule: Define metric purpose, denominator, freshness, and failure modes before using it.
invariant: Metrics do not imply causation or hide selection bias.
reject_or_block: Vanity metrics, missing denominator, stale dashboards.
deterministic_test: Backfill/late-data and null-data tests.
failure_response: Label inconclusive; investigate data pipeline.

rule: Test keyboard, focus, labels, contrast, motion, and error recovery with assistive workflows.
invariant: Core tasks remain operable without pointer/vision/hearing assumptions.
reject_or_block: Mouse-only controls, focus traps, color-only meaning.
evidence: Accessibility test results and semantic tree.
deterministic_test: Keyboard-only and screen-reader smoke tests.
failure_response: Block release for critical task failure.

rule: Add clear scope, preview, undo/retention, and confirmation proportional to irreversibility.
invariant: Users cannot accidentally perform high-impact irreversible action.
reject_or_block: Ambiguous labels, bulk default selection, irreversible one-click action.
deterministic_test: Test misclick/bulk-selection scenarios.
failure_response: Require confirmation/undo or deny.

rule: Treat model output as untrusted proposal requiring validation, policy checks, and accountable approval.
invariant: AI cannot bypass compiler/security/release boundaries.
reject_or_block: Auto-merging generated code, hallucinated test claims.
deterministic_test: Feed malicious/inaccurate suggestions.
failure_response: Reject or route through normal review.

rule: Give model integrations minimum data scope, redaction, retention, and user visibility.
invariant: Sensitive data is not broadly exposed for convenience.
reject_or_block: Uploading source/secrets by default, unclear external retention.
deterministic_test: Use sentinel secret/private code fixture.
failure_response: Block/redact; require consent/approved enclave.

rule: Label scores as estimates; expose inputs, uncertainty, and override path.
invariant: A score is not misrepresented as proof or policy.
reject_or_block: Automated denial/approval without calibration.
deterministic_test: Test edge/distribution-shift inputs.
failure_response: Escalate to human or safe fallback.

rule: Preserve deterministic IDs, hierarchy, rest pose, constraints, and validation on export/import.
invariant: Imported scene/rig reconstructs intended editable structure.
reject_or_block: Flattening hierarchy, missing constraints, lossy unnamed nodes.
deterministic_test: Export/import and compare transforms/keys.
failure_response: Reject invalid export; keep source unchanged.

rule: Compute vectors from immutable pose snapshots before mutating joints; enforce length and convergence limits.
invariant: IK/FK solver preserves bone constraints and degrades safely when unreachable.
reject_or_block: Mutation-order collapse, NaN target, unbounded iteration.
deterministic_test: Test reachable, unreachable, coincident, degenerate targets.
failure_response: Clamp/retain last valid pose; report unreachable.

rule: Validate keyframe time/order/interpolation and clamp playback bounds.
invariant: Timeline edits cannot create undefined interpolation or overflow.
reject_or_block: Duplicate unordered keys, negative duration, invalid easing.
deterministic_test: Test insert/delete/scrub at boundaries.
failure_response: Normalize/reject edit; preserve prior valid state.

rule: Separate decorative simulation from measured physical/operational truth.
invariant: Users can distinguish heuristic visuals from evidence.
reject_or_block: False-physics labels, implied security guarantees.
evidence: Legend, model assumptions, source metric IDs.
deterministic_test: Compare label against underlying data contract.
failure_response: Downgrade wording; annotate uncertainty.

rule: For every new boundary, document owner, contract, invariants, reject path, tests, and telemetry.
invariant: A boundary is operationally complete only with failure semantics.
reject_or_block: Happy-path-only design, no owner, no test.
deterministic_test: Review a new component with injected faults.
failure_response: Block integration until closure.
